svg.title: stable-knobs
svg.desc: Left: decay bias multiplying attention weights, toy 10 tokens. ALiBi-like constant forget gate f = 0.8 gives the same smooth decay in every row; FoX with data-dependent gates (f = 0.97 except f = 0.05 at token 5) keeps the past until token 5 and then wipes everything before it. Right: differential attention, toy 10 keys: softmax 1 puts 0.46 on key 6 and 0.06 on each other key; lambda times softmax 2 with lambda = 0.6 is 0.06 everywhere; the difference keeps 0.40 on key 6 and zero elsewhere. lambda_init = 0.8 - 0.6 exp(-0.3(l - 1)) is 0.20 at layer 1, 0.56 at layer 4 and 0.79 at layer 16.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: FoX: etj = qt ⊤ kj /√ dh + ct - cj
